learning_objective: 🎯 Let us master the Exclamation mark, the magic Apostrophe, and the talking Quotation marks!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use an exclamation mark (!) at the end of a sentence that shows strong emotion like anger, extreme joy, or surprise. Example: What a huge dinosaur!
The magic apostrophe (') can squeeze two words into one by hiding some letters! For example, 'Do not' becomes 'Don't', and 'I am' becomes 'I'm'.
We use quotation marks around words to show the exact words a person is speaking. Example: Ravi smiled and said, "I love eating chocolate ice cream!"

fun_activity.title: 💬 Speech Bubble Fun
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a picture of your favourite cartoon character. Draw a speech bubble next to them and write what they are saying using Quotation Marks!

quick_recap: ⭐ Exclamation marks (!) are used to show excitement, surprise, or strong feelings.
⭐ The apostrophe (') is used to make short squeezed words called contractions.
⭐ Quotation marks (" ") trap the exact words that a person speaks out loud.
